faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bank of Baroda FLC Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Bank of Baroda FLC Counsellor posts is 30th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the FLC Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree from a recognized University. A Post Graduate degree in Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Sociology, Psychology, or Social work is preferred. Additionally, knowledge of local language, teaching flair, and computer skills are essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the FLC Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the FLC Counsellor post is 64 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the FLC Counsellor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 25,000 per month. Additionally, reimbursement for conveyance expenses is provided, up to Rs. 5,000 or Rs. 3,000 per month based on the number of camps conducted.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Bank of Baroda FLC Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the FLC Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the FLC Counsellor position will be based on an Interview. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the FLC Counsellor post in this recruitment drive by Bank of Baroda.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is required for this post?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5 years of experience is required in specific fields such as nationalized banks, RRBs, private banks, business correspondent roles, or as an Ex RSETI Director/Faculty, or in related NBFCs/FIs.
